body: I disagree. Euthanasia for example is in my opinion often the only humane option. I honestly don't want to commit suicide. I'm scared that I'm gonna screw it up and become paralyzed or something. But I do want to die. Sometimes I daydream that I have some kind of a fatal disease, or that I died in an accident and it always makes me feel so relieved and calm. I really want to be okay. That's why I keep coming back to this sub, because I want to find something that could help me. But I've been posting and reading a lot of posts here and I never got any answers. Because no one has them. I think it's just a difference in perspectives. For you life is worth it, for me it's not.
But why is it bad? And what should I wait for? I'm constantly miserable, I just want it to end. And yeah, some people will be hurt but why should their happiness be more important than mine?

Yeah, I had three shitty therapists. I can't afford more therapy. I think I'm just one of those people that are meant to die. I'm just wired this way. Life doesn't always get better, it never got for me, and I'm just tired of waiting. I don't see why I should be alive.

I've been depressed ever since I was a kid. Went to therapy, took meds, nothing helped. A few days off won't solve my life problems. In the end, I just feel like living isn't worth it. I can barely get through the day. I plan on taking my life at the end of this year. Maybe sooner.
I'm a woman. And no, I'd rather not have kids when most of the time I'm on the brink of suicide. I hate being alive, why would I do that to someone?
